title: French-Style Banh Mi Tofu Sandwich
description: A fusion twist on the classic French baguette, featuring crispy tofu, fresh herbs, and a hint of Vietnamese flavors.

ingredients.name: Tofu
ingredients.notes: Extra-firm, drained and cut into 1-inch cubes

instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown, about 5-7 minutes.
Meanwhile, toast the baguette by grilling it for a few minutes or baking it in the oven at 350°F (175°C) for 5 minutes.
Spread the mayonnaise on the toasted baguette.
Add the cooked tofu, pickled carrots, cucumber, mint leaves, and chili sauce on top of the mayonnaise.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Optional: Top with a fried egg or grilled pork for added protein.
Optional: Serve with a side of steamed vegetables or a simple green salad.
